label: Priya · back after 5 years raising children

story.pastWork: I worked as an administrative coordinator at Alpine Property Management in Orem for six years, from 2015 to 2021. I managed calendars, scheduled meetings, coordinated vendors, and prepared reports using Excel.
story.breakStory: In 2021 I took a five-year break to raise my children. Now that they're in school, I'm ready to return to work, but I need to finish in time for school pickup.
story.breakActivities: During my break, I helped organize school events and volunteer schedules.

story.pastWork: I was an operations manager at Summit Freight Logistics in Salt Lake City from 2016 to 2024, and an operations coordinator there from 2012 to 2016. As manager I led a team of 14 dispatchers and warehouse leads, owned a $2.1 million annual operating budget, and cut late deliveries by 18% by redesigning our route schedule. I also chose and managed our three main trucking vendors.
story.breakStory: In 2024 I left to care for my mother after a serious illness. She is doing well now, and I'm ready to go back to full-time work.
story.breakActivities: While caring for her I managed her appointments and insurance paperwork. I also volunteer as treasurer for our neighborhood association, tracking a $40,000 yearly budget in Excel and presenting it at quarterly meetings.

story.pastWork: I worked as a server and host at Riverside Grill in Provo from 2017 to 2019. I greeted guests, took orders, ran the register, and counted the cash drawer at closing.
story.breakStory: From 2020 to now I've been home raising my children.
story.breakActivities: I volunteer in the front office at my kids' elementary school a few mornings a month. I check in visitors, answer questions from parents, and make copies for teachers. I also helped run the checkout table at the school book fair.
